evidence_boundary: This audit tests only path reachability against the live repository tree. It does not determine whether an unreachable historical artifact should be recreated, whether its underlying claim remains correct, or whether a planned reverse index has enough source data to regenerate safely. Direct absence checks do not establish that historical artifacts should be recreated; no replacement was generated without a live producer/consumer contract.
next: Continue with live-present validators/consumers and deterministic projections. Treat absent historical/index-only registrations as provenance unless a current source layer and consumer require reconstruction.
